    "FUNCTION RPY_DYNPRO_READ.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(PROGNAME) LIKE  D020S-PROG",
    "*\"     VALUE(DYNNR) LIKE  D020S-DNUM",
    "*\"     VALUE(SUPPRESS_EXIST_CHECKS) TYPE  C DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"     VALUE(SUPPRESS_CORR_CHECKS) TYPE  C DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(HEADER) LIKE  RPY_DYHEAD STRUCTURE  RPY_DYHEAD",
    "*\"  TABLES",
    "*\"      CONTAINERS TYPE  DYCATT_TAB OPTIONAL",
    "*\"      FIELDS_TO_CONTAINERS TYPE  DYFATC_TAB OPTIONAL",
    "*\"      FLOW_LOGIC STRUCTURE  RPY_DYFLOW OPTIONAL",
    "*\"      PARAMS STRUCTURE  RPY_DYPARA OPTIONAL",
    "*\"  EXCEPTIONS",
    "*\"      CANCELLED",
    "*\"      NOT_FOUND",
    "*\"      PERMISSION_ERROR",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "",
    "",
    "************************************************************************",
    "* 1. Lesen des Dynpros im internen Format",
    "************************************************************************",
    "",
    "* Beim Lesen im internen Format werden folgende Bestandteile des Dynpros",
    "* sofort im externen Format bereitgestellt, da sie sich zwischen",
    "* internem und externem Format nicht unterscheiden:",
    "* - Ablauflogik",
    "* - Dynprobeschreibungstext",
    "",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'RPY_DYNPRO_READ_NATIVE'",
    "      EXPORTING",
    "           PROGNAME               = PROGNAME",
    "           DYNNR                  = DYNNR",
    "           SUPPRESS_EXIST_CHECKS  = SUPPRESS_EXIST_CHECKS",
    "           SUPPRESS_CORR_CHECKS   = SUPPRESS_CORR_CHECKS",
    "      IMPORTING",
    "           HEADER           =  HEADER_INT",
    "           DYNPROTEXT       =  DYNP_HEADER-DESCRIPT",
    "      TABLES",
    "           FIELDLIST        =  FIELDLIST_INT",
    "           FLOWLOGIC        =  FLOW_LOGIC",
    "           PARAMS           =  PARAMS_INT",
    "*          FIELDTEXTS       =",
    "      EXCEPTIONS",
    "           CANCELLED        = 1",
    "           NOT_FOUND        = 2",
    "           PERMISSION_ERROR = 3",
    "           OTHERS           = 4.",
    "  IF SY-SUBRC NE 0.",
    "    CASE SY-SUBRC.",
    "      WHEN 1. MESSAGE ID SY-MSGID TYPE SY-MSGTY NUMBER SY-MSGNO",
    "                      WITH SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4",
    "                  RAISING CANCELLED.",
    "      WHEN 2. MESSAGE ID SY-MSGID TYPE SY-MSGTY NUMBER SY-MSGNO",
    "                      WITH SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4",
    "                  RAISING NOT_FOUND.",
    "      WHEN 3. MESSAGE ID SY-MSGID TYPE SY-MSGTY NUMBER SY-MSGNO",
    "                      WITH SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4",
    "                  RAISING PERMISSION_ERROR.",
    "      WHEN OTHERS.",
    "              MESSAGE ID SY-MSGID TYPE SY-MSGTY NUMBER SY-MSGNO",
    "                      WITH SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4",
    "                  RAISING CANCELLED.",
    "    ENDCASE.",
    "    EXIT.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "************************************************************************",
    "* 2. Konvertierung internes -> externes Format",
    "************************************************************************",
    "",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'RPY_DYNPRO_CVT_INTO_EXTFORMAT'",
    "       EXPORTING",
    "            HEADER_INT           = HEADER_INT",
    "            DESCRIPT             = DYNP_HEADER-DESCRIPT",
    "       IMPORTING",
    "            HEADER               = HEADER",
    "       TABLES",
    "            FIELDS_TO_CONTAINERS = FIELDS_TO_CONTAINERS",
    "            FIELDS_INT           = FIELDLIST_INT",
    "            CONTAINERS           = CONTAINERS",
    "            PARAMS_INT           = PARAMS_INT",
    "            PARAMS               = PARAMS",
    "       EXCEPTIONS",
    "            OTHERS               = 1.",
    "  if sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "    MESSAGE ID SY-MSGID TYPE SY-MSGTY NUMBER SY-MSGNO",
    "               WITH SY-MSGV1 SY-MSGV2 SY-MSGV3 SY-MSGV4",
    "            raising cancelled.",
    "  endif.",
    "",
    "ENDFUNCTION."
  ],
